a.label: Alien Rapture: The Chosen, Galde Press, 1998

edges.label: The book the presentation was given to promote; its TR-3B content was NOT opened
edges.note: CAVEAT CARRIED ON THE EDGE, AND IT IS THE REASON FOR TIER 3. The presentation names the book as its occasion at slide 5, which is Tier 1. But no copy of the book's text was opened, so how or whether the TR-3B appears inside it is unestablished. The edge records the promotional relationship only, and must not be read as the book containing the claim.

edges.label: Author and copyright holder of the presentation transcript
edges.note: INTENT: AUTHORSHIP. The board has no authorship edge type, and authorship is deliberately NOT built as custody here, because custody is weighted x3.0 as a program edge and giving a claimant a x3 edge to his own document would inflate him. Mapped to research. The document's first four lines are 'Presentation to IUFOR by / Edgar Rothshild Fouche / Copyright Aug. 1998 / Fouche Media Associates'.

edges.label: Documented ten weeks temporary duty in 1979, plus extensive first-person narration in the 1998 presentation
edges.note: The strongest documented connection between any TR-3B claimant and a real classified airfield, and it must be read with its own limit attached: the form does not say what he did there, referring that out to 'a separate report' that is not in the file, and everything else on the form describes F-15 avionics intermediate shop work. The extensive Groom Lake narration in the 1998 presentation, including helicopter flights and a mess hall conversation about an NSA system, is Tier 2 on his word alone.

edges.label: Originating claimant of the TR-3B, August 1998
edges.note: The claim exists in his copyrighted document and nowhere earlier that was opened. Tier 2 and not 1 because the edge asserts that he is the origin of the claim, which rests on the absence of an earlier source rather than on a positive record. Note that within the artefact itself the sighting is second hand: slide 69 opens 'A friend said, he would never forget the sight of the alien looking TR-3B based at Papoose.' He does not claim to have seen it.

edges.label: The dated artefact that carries the claim; opened in full
edges.note: The dossier proposed this as a custody edge. Built as investigative to match the board's existing precedent for a document carrying a claim about a craft, scott-sorensen-notes-1990 to arv-fluxliner, which is investigative and not custody. A transcript has custody of the record of the claim, not of the craft, and the distinction is worth keeping since custody carries the x3.0 program weighting.

a.label: Testor Corp. SR-75 Penetrator and XR-7 Thunderdart model kits, 1993

edges.label: Prior art: the SR-75 Penetrator designation and mothership architecture published commercially in 1993
edges.note: A stated inference and graded 3 accordingly. The designation and the mothership architecture are published, dated and boxed in 1993 with a named designer, and the Air Force told the same newspaper 'such a plane does not exist'. They reappear in 1998 as inside knowledge. The direction of priority is documented and one-directional; the direction of influence is not established and must not be inverted by a later session.

edges.label: CLAIMED ONLY: named as a funder and tasker at slide 70
edges.note: A claim about what Fouche said, from the same sentence as the NRO and NSA edges. No record connecting the CIA to this designation was opened.

edges.label: CLAIMED ONLY: named as a funder and tasker at slide 70
edges.note: A claim about what Fouche said, not about the agency. 'It is funded and operationally tasked by the National Reconnaissance Office, the NSA, and the CIA.' No record of any kind connecting the NRO to this designation was opened.

edges.label: CLAIMED ONLY: named as a funder and tasker at slide 70
edges.note: A claim about what Fouche said, from the same sentence as the NRO and CIA edges. No record connecting the NSA to this designation was opened.

edges.label: CLAIMED ONLY: named as a developer of the Magnetic Field Disrupter at slide 72
edges.note: A claim about what Fouche said. 'Sandia and Livermore laboratories developed the reverse engineered MFD technology.' No lawrence-livermore node exists on the board and none is proposed here, so only the Sandia half of the sentence is wired. No record connecting either laboratory to this claim was opened, and the propulsion specification the sentence introduces is refuted by the melting point of its own working fluid.
